relationships.query: DEFINE VAR missing = EXCEPT(SELECTCOLUMNS(FILTER(ALLNOBLANKROW('Flights'[%Aircraft Type ID]), NOT ISBLANK('Flights'[%Aircraft Type ID])), "k", 'Flights'[%Aircraft Type ID]), SELECTCOLUMNS(ALLNOBLANKROW('Aircrafts'[%Aircraft Type ID]), "k", 'Aircrafts'[%Aircraft Type ID])) EVALUATE ROW("unmatched_keys", COUNTROWS(missing) + 0, "unmatched_rows", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Flights'), REMOVEFILTERS(), TREATAS(missing, 'Flights'[%Aircraft Type ID])) + 0, "duplicate_keys", COUNTROWS(ALLNOBLANKROW('Aircrafts')) - COUNTROWS(ALLNOBLANKROW('Aircrafts'[%Aircraft Type ID])))
